tasks.title: WP-M3-01 gap-balance: telemetry slots, decayed EWMA, in-flight guard, breaker, retry budget, P2C. Deliverables: TelemetrySlot/Registry (dense slab, ArcSwap), DecayedEwma (packed CAS), InFlightGuard (RAII), Breaker FSM with 10x3 s bucket window, RetryBudget, P2C selection, Health-driven capacity weight; tests: 64-thread lost-update test, cancel 10,000 futures => in_flight==0, FSM table-driven + shuttle interleavings, herding simulation (no share swing > 20%), retry-budget exhaustion; criterion benches: selection <= 20 us p99, update <= 1 us p99; crates/gap-balance/Cargo.toml declares each bench with harness = false and sets [lib] bench = false, otherwise `cargo bench -- --quick` hands --quick to the libtest harness of the lib target and fails (reviewer-verified 2026-10-27); criterion is used with features = ["cargo_bench_support"] (root pin disables default features). Acceptance (must pass): cargo nextest run -p gap-balance && cargo bench -p gap-balance -- --quick && cargo clippy -p gap-balance --all-targets -- -D warnings
